integrity: No unproved hypothesis is needed. Explicit unrestricted combinatorial bijections and coefficient identities; finite verification is corroboration rather than a proof. The univariate tribonacci sequence is already documented.
limitations: Finite simple paths only, independent families of all nonempty connected vertex subsets, unweighted cardinalities and one-blob replacement of maximum packings only. Independent priority review not performed; earlier interval-packing literature may encode portions of the enumerators.
title: Exact independent and maximal-packing spectra and triangular-cactus exchange geometry of path blob graphs
